blocks.text: if I had known — o'tmishdagi xayoliy holat

38–39-darslarda xayoliy shart **hozir** haqida edi: If I **knew**, I**'d** tell you. O'tmishdagi xayoliy holat uchun zamonlar yana bir qadam orqaga suriladi: **If** + **Past Perfect** (→ 15-dars), natijada **would have** + V3 (→ 36-dars). If I **had known** about the party, I **would have come** — Bazm haqida **bilganimda**, **kelgan bo'lardim** (lekin bilmadim va kelmadim). Bunday gaplarning hammasi o'tmishdagi haqiqatning teskarisi: bo'lmagan narsa haqida xayol, ko'pincha afsus yoki tanqid.

rows: If I**'d** + V3, I**'d have** + V3
If I**'d known**, I**'d have helped**.

items.text: If we **had left** on time, we **wouldn't have missed** the start of the film.
Kate **would have called** you if she **had had** your number.

blocks.text: Hozir yoki o'tmish: if I knew / if I had known

O'zbekchada ikkala holat ham «**bilganimda**» bo'lishi mumkin — farq faqat natija qismida: «aytardim» (hozir) va «**aytgan bo'lardim**» (o'tmish). Ingliz tilida esa farq **ikkala qismda** ham ko'rinadi: If I **knew** her number, I**'d call** her — hozir raqamni bilmayman. If I **had known** her number, I**'d have called** her yesterday — kecha bilmagan edim. Vaqtni aniq tasavvur qiling: gap hozir haqidami yoki tugagan voqea haqidami?

rows: If I **had** time, I**'d help** you.
If I **had had** time, I**'d have helped** you.
I wish I **had known** the answer.

items.text: If I **spoke** French, I**'d apply** for the job in Paris.
If I **had spoken** French, I**'d have applied** for that job last year.
items.translation: Fransuzcha **bilganimda**, o'tgan yili o'sha ishga **ariza topshirgan bo'lardim**.

blocks.text: Og'zaki nutqda ikkala qismda ham **'d** eshitiladi: If I**'d known**, I**'d have told** you. Birinchi 'd — **had**, ikkinchisi — **would**. Ajratish oson: **'d** + V3 (known, seen, gone) → **had**; **'d** + **have** yoki asosiy shakl → **would**. Esda tuting: if-qismda **would** ishlatilmaydi — «If I would have known» xato, garchi ona tilida so'zlashuvchilar ham og'zaki nutqda ba'zan shunday deb qo'yishsa ham. To'g'risi: If I **had known**.

Natija qismida **would have** o'rniga: **could have** + V3 — «**-a olgan bo'lardim**», «**-ishim mumkin edi**» (imkoniyat bor edi, lekin foydalanilmadi): If you'd asked, I **could have helped** you. **might have** + V3 — «**balki ...gan bo'lardi**» (ehtimol): If we'd left earlier, we **might have caught** the train. Inkor: **couldn't have** + V3 — «-a olmagan bo'lardim».

items.text: If the shop **had been** open, we **could have bought** a present for Aziz.
items.translation: Do'kon ochiq **bo'lganida**, Azizga sovg'a **sotib olishimiz mumkin edi**.

items.text: If Emma **had trained** harder, she **might have won** the race.
items.translation: Emma qattiqroq **mashq qilganida**, balki poygada **g'olib bo'lgan bo'lardi**.

blocks.text: I wish I had done — o'tmishdagi afsus

**wish** + **Past Perfect** — o'tmishda bo'lgan yoki bo'lmagan narsadan afsus: I **wish** I **had studied** harder at school — **Qani endi** maktabda yaxshiroq **o'qigan bo'lsam**. I **wish** I **hadn't said** that — Buni **aytmasam bo'lar ekan** / **aytganimga afsuslanaman**. **If only** I **had** ... — xuddi shu ma'no, faqat kuchliroq his bilan. Solishtiring: I wish I **knew** (hozir bilmayman) — I wish I **had known** (o'shanda bilmagan edim). «I wish I would have» — xato.

items.text: I **wish** I **had taken** more photos when we were in Khiva.
items.translation: **Qani endi** Xivada bo'lganimizda ko'proq **surat olgan bo'lsam**.

items.text: Bekzod **wishes** he **hadn't sold** his old car so cheaply.
items.translation: Bekzod eski mashinasini shunchalik arzonga **sotib yuborganiga afsuslanadi**.

blocks.text: Aralash shart: shart o'tmishda, natija esa hozir bo'lishi mumkin. If I **had studied** medicine, I **would be** a doctor now — Tibbiyotni **o'qiganimda**, hozir shifokor **bo'lardim**. Bunday gapda natija qismi oddiy **would** + fe'l bo'ladi, chunki u hozir haqida.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «If I knew about it yesterday, I would come» → If I **had known** about it yesterday, I **would have come** (o'tmish — Past Perfect va would have); «If I would have known» → If I **had known** (if-qismda would yo'q); «I would have went» → I would have **gone** (V3); «I wish I didn't say that» (o'tmish haqida) → I wish I **hadn't said** that; «I wish I would have studied» → I wish I **had studied**.

O'tmishdagi xayoliy shartni o'zbekcha «**...ganimda, ...gan bo'lardim**» qolipi bilan tekshiring: ikkala qismda ham «-gan» bor — inglizchada ham ikkala qismda ham V3 bor: **had known** ... **would have come**. Bitta qismda V3 tushib qolsa, gap noto'g'ri.

rows: If I'd known, I **would have** come.
If it **hadn't** rained, we **wouldn't have** stayed in.

examples.title: **If** I **had known**, I **would have** ...
examples.description: If + Past Perfect, would have + V3 — o'tmishda bo'lmagan narsa haqida xayol. O'zbekchada «...ganimda, ...gan bo'lardim».

sentences.text: If I **had known** about the traffic, I **would have taken** the metro.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlik haqida **bilganimda**, metroda **ketgan bo'lardim**.

sentences.text: We **would have arrived** on time if the taxi driver **had known** the way.
sentences.translation: Taksi haydovchisi yo'lni **bilganida**, o'z vaqtida **yetib kelgan bo'lardik**.

sentences.text: If Madina **had studied** a bit harder, she**'d have got** a scholarship.
sentences.translation: Madina biroz ko'proq **o'qiganida**, grant **olgan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Tom **would have called** you if he**'d had** your new number.
sentences.translation: Yangi raqamingiz **bo'lganida**, Tom sizga **qo'ng'iroq qilgan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: If we**'d left** ten minutes earlier, we **would have caught** the train.
sentences.translation: O'n daqiqa oldin **chiqqanimizda**, poyezdga **ulgurgan bo'lardik**.

sentences.text: The match **would have been** more exciting if both teams **had played** to win.
sentences.translation: Ikkala jamoa g'alaba uchun **o'ynaganida**, o'yin qiziqarliroq **bo'lgan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Emma **would have bought** the house in Oxford if the price **had been** a little lower.
sentences.translation: Narx biroz pastroq **bo'lganida**, Emma Oksforddagi o'sha uyni **sotib olgan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: I**'d have baked** you a cake if you**'d told** me it was your birthday.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuningiz ekanini **aytganingizda**, sizga tort **pishirgan bo'lardim**.

sentences.text: Aziz **would have enjoyed** the trip to Khiva much more if he **hadn't been** ill.
sentences.translation: Kasal **bo'lmaganida**, Aziz Xivaga sayohatdan ancha ko'proq **zavqlangan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Looking back, Kate thinks she **would have been** happier if she**'d studied** law.
sentences.translation: Hozir o'ylab qarasa, Keyt huquqshunoslikni **o'qiganida**, baxtliroq **bo'lgan bo'lardi**, deb hisoblaydi.

examples.title: Negative: **If** ... **hadn't**, ... **wouldn't have**
examples.description: Inkor shakllar: hadn't + V3, wouldn't have + V3. Haqiqatda bo'lgan narsa — teskarisi tasavvur qilinadi.

sentences.text: If it **hadn't rained**, we **would have had** the wedding in the garden.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir **yog'maganida**, to'yni bog'da **o'tkazgan bo'lardik**.

sentences.text: I **wouldn't have made** that mistake if I**'d read** the instructions carefully.
sentences.translation: Yo'riqnomani diqqat bilan **o'qiganimda**, bu xatoga **yo'l qo'ymagan bo'lardim**.

sentences.text: If Jasur **hadn't missed** the bus, he **wouldn't have been** late for his exam.
sentences.translation: Jasur avtobusdan **qolib ketmaganida**, imtihoniga **kechikmagan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **wouldn't have complained** if we**'d turned** the music down earlier.
sentences.translation: Musiqani ertaroq **pasaytirganimizda**, qo'shnilarimiz **shikoyat qilmagan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **wouldn't have met** her husband if she **hadn't gone** to that conference in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Manchesterdagi o'sha konferensiyaga **bormaganida**, Sara eri bilan **tanishmagan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: If the doctors **hadn't acted** so quickly, the patient **wouldn't have survived**.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar shunchalik tez **harakat qilmaganida**, bemor **omon qolmagan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: The project **wouldn't have failed** if the managers **had listened** to the engineers.
sentences.translation: Rahbarlar muhandislarga **quloq solganida**, loyiha **barbod bo'lmagan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: We **wouldn't have found** this lovely little café if we **hadn't got** lost.
sentences.translation: **Adashib qolmaganimizda**, bu yoqimli kichkina kafeni **topmagan bo'lardik**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **would never have learnt** to swim if her father **hadn't been** so patient.
sentences.translation: Otasi shunchalik sabrli **bo'lmaganida**, Nilufar hech qachon suzishni **o'rganmagan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Honestly, if you **hadn't reminded** me, I**'d have forgotten** all about the meeting.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, siz **eslatmaganingizda**, yig'ilish haqida butunlay **unutib qo'ygan bo'lardim**.

examples.title: Questions: What **would** you **have done** if ...?
examples.description: O'tmish haqida xayoliy savollar: What / Where / How would you have ... if ...? Would you have ...?

sentences.text: What **would** you **have done** if you**'d lost** your passport in London?
sentences.translation: Londonda pasportingizni **yo'qotib qo'yganingizda**, nima **qilgan bo'lardingiz**?

sentences.text: **Would** you **have accepted** the job if they**'d offered** you more money?
sentences.translation: Ko'proq pul **taklif qilishganida**, ishni **qabul qilgan bo'larmidingiz**?

sentences.text: How **would** your life **have been** different if you**'d grown up** in a village?
sentences.translation: Qishloqda **ulg'ayganingizda**, hayotingiz qanday boshqacha **bo'lgan bo'lardi**?

sentences.text: Where **would** we **have stayed** if your cousin **hadn't** let us use his flat?
sentences.translation: Amakivachchangiz kvartirasidan foydalanishimizga **ruxsat bermaganida**, qayerda **qolgan bo'lardik**?

sentences.text: If the bus **hadn't** come, how **would** you **have got** home?
sentences.translation: Avtobus **kelmaganida**, uyga qanday **yetib olgan bo'lardingiz**?

sentences.text: **Would** Bekzod **have passed** the interview if he**'d prepared** better?
sentences.translation: Yaxshiroq **tayyorlanganida**, Bekzod suhbatdan **o'tgan bo'larmidi**?

sentences.text: Who **would have looked** after the children if Grandma **hadn't been** free?
sentences.translation: Buvim bo'sh **bo'lmaganida**, bolalarga kim **qaragan bo'lardi**?

sentences.text: If you**'d been** in my place, **would** you **have said** anything to the manager?
sentences.translation: Mening o'rnimda **bo'lganingizda**, menejerga biror narsa **degan bo'larmidingiz**?

sentences.text: Which university **would** you **have chosen** if money **hadn't been** a problem?
sentences.translation: Pul muammo **bo'lmaganida**, qaysi universitetni **tanlagan bo'lardingiz**?

sentences.text: Do you think the team **would have won** if Oliver **had played**?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, Oliver **o'ynaganida**, jamoa **g'alaba qozongan bo'larmidi**?

examples.title: **could have** / **might have** in the result
examples.description: could have + V3 — imkoniyat bor edi, lekin foydalanilmadi; might have + V3 — balki shunday bo'lardi.

sentences.text: If we**'d had** a map, we **could have found** the waterfall much more easily.
sentences.translation: Xaritamiz **bo'lganida**, sharsharani ancha oson **topa olgan bo'lardik**.

sentences.text: Kate **might have got** the job if she**'d applied** a week earlier.
sentences.translation: Bir hafta oldin **ariza topshirganida**, Keyt balki ishga **kirgan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: You **could have stayed** with us if you**'d told** us you were coming to Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Toshkentga kelishingizni **aytganingizda**, biznikida **qolishingiz mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: If Madina **had trained** harder, she **might have won** a medal at the championship.
sentences.translation: Madina qattiqroq **mashq qilganida**, chempionatda balki medal **yutgan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: We **could have saved** a lot of money if we**'d booked** the flights in January.
sentences.translation: Aviachiptalarni yanvarda **band qilganimizda**, ko'p pul **tejashimiz mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: If you **hadn't** helped me, I **couldn't have finished** the report in time.
sentences.translation: Siz **yordam bermaganingizda**, hisobotni vaqtida **tugata olmagan bo'lardim**.

sentences.text: James **might have enjoyed** the party more if he **hadn't been** so tired.
sentences.translation: Bunchalik charchagan **bo'lmaganida**, Jeyms bazmdan balki ko'proq **zavqlangan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: With better marketing, the restaurant **could have survived** its first difficult year.
sentences.translation: Marketing yaxshiroq **bo'lganida**, restoran birinchi og'ir yilini **eson-omon o'tkaza olgan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Things **might have been** very different if my parents **hadn't** moved to Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam Toshkentga **ko'chib kelmaganida**, hammasi butunlay boshqacha **bo'lishi mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: Why didn't you ask me? I **could have lent** you the money!
sentences.translation: Nega mendan so'ramadingiz? Sizga pulni **qarzga bera olardim**-ku!

examples.title: **I wish** I **had** done ...: regrets
examples.description: wish + Past Perfect — o'tmishda qilinmagan narsadan afsus. O'zbekchada «qani endi ...gan bo'lsam», «...maganiga afsuslanadi».

sentences.text: I **wish** I **had learnt** English as a child — it would have been much easier.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** ingliz tilini bolaligimda **o'rgangan bo'lsam** — ancha oson bo'lgan bo'lardi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **wishes** she **had taken** more photos at her graduation.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bitiruvida ko'proq **surat olmaganiga afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: We **wish** we**'d visited** Samarkand in spring, when the weather is milder.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** Samarqandga bahorda, havo mo'tadilroq bo'lganda **borgan bo'lsak**.

sentences.text: Tom **wishes** he**'d listened** to his father's advice about money.
sentences.translation: Tom pul masalasida otasining maslahatiga **quloq solmaganiga afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: Don't you **wish** you**'d bought** bitcoin ten years ago?
sentences.translation: O'n yil oldin bitkoin **sotib olmaganingizga afsuslanmaysizmi**?

sentences.text: Everyone **wishes** they **had spent** more time with their grandparents.
sentences.translation: Hamma buvi-buvalari bilan ko'proq **vaqt o'tkazmaganiga afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: Now that the shop has closed, I really **wish** I**'d bought** that jacket.
sentences.translation: Do'kon yopilib qolgan ekan, **qani endi** o'sha kurtkani **sotib olgan bo'lsam**.

sentences.text: My brother **wishes** he **had gone** to university instead of starting work at eighteen.
sentences.translation: Akam o'n sakkiz yoshida ishga kirish o'rniga universitetga **bormaganiga afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: If only I**'d checked** the weather forecast before we set off!
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** yo'lga chiqishdan oldin ob-havo ma'lumotini **tekshirgan bo'lsam**!

sentences.text: Looking at the photos, Oliver **wishes** he **had been** at his best friend's wedding.
sentences.translation: Suratlarga qarab, Oliver eng yaqin do'stining to'yida **bo'lmaganiga afsuslanadi**.

examples.title: **I wish** I **hadn't** ... / **If only** I **hadn't** ...
examples.description: wish + hadn't + V3 — qilingan ishdan afsus. If only — xuddi shu, kuchliroq his bilan.

sentences.text: I **wish** I **hadn't eaten** so much at dinner — now I can't sleep.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** kechki ovqatda bunchalik ko'p **yemagan bo'lsam** — endi uxlay olmayapman.

sentences.text: Madina **wishes** she **hadn't told** her colleagues about her new boyfriend.
sentences.translation: Madina hamkasblariga yangi yigiti haqida **aytib qo'yganiga afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: If only we **hadn't sold** our old house — prices have doubled since then!
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** eski uyimizni **sotmagan bo'lsak** — o'shandan beri narxlar ikki baravar oshdi!

sentences.text: Aziz **wishes** he **hadn't said** such unkind things to his sister.
sentences.translation: Aziz singlisiga shunday qo'pol gaplarni **aytganiga afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: Many people **wish** they **hadn't spent** so much time on their phones as teenagers.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik o'smirligida telefonda shuncha ko'p **vaqt o'tkazganiga afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: Honestly, I **wish** I **hadn't agreed** to organise the office party.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, **qani endi** ofis bazmini tashkil qilishga **rozi bo'lmagan bo'lsam**.

sentences.text: Don't you **wish** you **hadn't lent** him your car? — Yes, I really do.
sentences.translation: Mashinangizni unga **qarzga berganingizga afsuslanmayapsizmi**? — Ha, juda afsuslanyapman.

sentences.text: Sarah **wishes** she **hadn't cut** her hair so short before the wedding.
sentences.translation: Sara to'ydan oldin sochini bunchalik kalta **qirqtirganiga afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: The minister probably **wishes** he **hadn't made** that joke on live television.
sentences.translation: Vazir, ehtimol, jonli efirda o'sha hazilni **qilganiga afsuslanayotgandir**.

sentences.text: If only I **hadn't left** my umbrella on the train this morning!
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** bugun ertalab soyabonimni poyezdda **qoldirib ketmagan bo'lsam**!

examples.title: Present or past? **If I knew** / **If I had known**
examples.description: Juft gaplar: avval hozirgi xayoliy holat (Past Simple + would), keyin o'tmishdagisi (Past Perfect + would have).

sentences.text: If I **knew** the answer, I**'d tell** you — but I really don't.
sentences.translation: Javobni **bilganimda**, sizga **aytardim** — lekin rostdan ham bilmayman.

sentences.text: If I**'d known** the answer, I**'d have told** you at the meeting yesterday.
sentences.translation: Javobni **bilganimda**, kechagi yig'ilishda sizga **aytgan bo'lardim**.

sentences.text: Jasur **would come** to the party if he **wasn't** working tonight.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **ishlamaganida**, Jasur bazmga **kelardi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **would have come** to the party if he **hadn't been** working last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun **ishlamaganida**, Jasur bazmga **kelgan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: We**'d go** out more often if we **had** someone to look after the kids.
sentences.translation: Bolalarga qarab turadigan odamimiz **bo'lganida**, tez-tez **tashqariga chiqardik**.

sentences.text: We**'d have gone** out last Saturday if we**'d had** someone to look after the kids.
sentences.translation: O'tgan shanba kuni bolalarga qarab turadigan odamimiz **bo'lganida**, **tashqariga chiqqan bo'lardik**.

sentences.text: Kate **wishes** she **lived** closer to her parents, who are getting older.
sentences.translation: Keyt **qani endi** keksayib qolgan ota-onamga yaqinroq **yashasam**, deydi.

sentences.text: Kate **wishes** she **had moved** back home when her father got ill.
sentences.translation: Keyt otasi kasal bo'lganda uyiga **qaytib kelmaganiga afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: This hotel **would be** perfect if it **wasn't** so close to the airport.
sentences.translation: Aeroportga bunchalik yaqin **bo'lmaganida**, bu mehmonxona **mukammal bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Our holiday **would have been** perfect if it **hadn't rained** on the last day.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi kuni yomg'ir **yog'maganida**, ta'tilimiz **mukammal bo'lgan bo'lardi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: the day everything went wrong
examples.description: Suhbat: Oliver reysdan qolib ketdi — o'tmishdagi xayoliy shart, could have, might have va wish + Past Perfect.

sentences.text: — Oliver, you look terrible! I **wish** you**'d called** me earlier.
sentences.translation: — Oliver, ahvoling yomon ko'rinadi! **Qani endi** menga ertaroq **qo'ng'iroq qilgan bo'lsang**.

sentences.text: — Sorry. If I **hadn't overslept**, none of this **would have happened**.
sentences.translation: — Kechir. **Uxlab qolmaganimda**, bularning hech biri **sodir bo'lmagan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: — Did you miss the flight to Edinburgh? If I**'d known**, I**'d have driven** you to the airport.
sentences.translation: — Edinburgga reysdan qoldingmi? **Bilganimda**, seni aeroportga mashinada **olib borgan bo'lardim**.

sentences.text: — Yes. If the taxi **had come** on time, I **might** still **have made** it.
sentences.translation: — Ha. Taksi o'z vaqtida **kelganida**, balki baribir **ulgurgan bo'lardim**.

sentences.text: — What a pity! **Couldn't** you **have taken** the next flight?
sentences.translation: — Attang! Keyingi reysga **chiqa olmasmiding**?

sentences.text: — It was full. If only I**'d bought** a flexible ticket!
sentences.translation: — To'la ekan. **Qani endi** o'zgartirsa bo'ladigan chipta **olgan bo'lsam**!

sentences.text: — Don't be so hard on yourself — you **couldn't have known** that the taxi would be late.
sentences.translation: — O'zingni bunchalik qiynama — taksining kechikishini **bila olmas eding**-ku.

sentences.text: — True, but if I**'d set** two alarms, I **would have woken up** in time.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri, lekin ikkita budilnik **qo'yganimda**, vaqtida **uyg'ongan bo'lardim**.

sentences.text: — Next time you will. And if you**'d told** me, I **would have reminded** you!
sentences.translation: — Keyingi safar shunday qilasan. Menga **aytganingda**, seni o'zim **eslatgan bo'lardim**!

sentences.text: — I know. I **wish** I**'d listened** to you when you suggested an earlier flight.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman. **Qani endi** sen ertaroq reysni taklif qilganingda **gapingga kirgan bo'lsam**.
